subject: general
question: An aquarium is in the form of a cuboid whose external measures are 80 cm × 30 cm × 40 cm. The base, side faces and back face are to be covered with the coloured paper. What is the area of paper needed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Area = Area of Base + Area of 2 Side Faces + Area of Back Face

Base Area = 80 × 30 = 2400 cm²

Side Faces Area = 2 × (30 × 40) = 2400 cm²

Back Face Area = 80 × 40 = 3200 cm²

Required Area = 2400 + 2400 + 3200 = 8000 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 8000 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 80 cm

Breadth (b) = 30 cm

Height (h) = 40 cm

 

 

 

 

 

 Length (l) = 80 cm
 Height (h) = 40 cm
 Breadth (b) = 30 cm
 Back face
 Base (Bottom)

**Formula Used:**

Area of paper needed = Area of base + Area of back face + 2 × Area of side faces

Area = (l × b) + (l × h) + 2(b × h)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of base = l × b = 80 × 30 = 2400 cm²

⇒ Area of back face = l × h = 80 × 40 = 3200 cm²

⇒ Area of two side faces = 2 × (b × h) = 2 × (30 × 40) = 2 × 1200 = 2400 cm²

⇒ Total Area = 2400 + 3200 + 2400

⇒ Total Area = 8000 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 8000 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total area of all six faces of a cuboid is given by 2(lb + bh + lh).

Lateral Surface Area of Cuboid

The area of the four vertical side faces (excluding top and base) is 2h(l + b).

Volume of Cuboid

The space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as Length × Breadth × Height (l × b × h).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboid is √(l² + b² + h²).</p
